verdict: FTSE 100 shares, 2026-08-25 to 2026-10-30 (48 trading days), 359 completed trades under the live rules; split at 2026-09-29 into an earlier and a later half. Data delay: each scan sees only candles that ended at least 15 minutes before it, as the live scanner does with Yahoo's delayed prices; the fill is still the next candle after the scan.

Chance test: the scanner made £-52.83. The same trades in a random direction averaged £-51.14; 55% of random versions did as well. At a random time the same day they averaged £-37.49; 95% did as well.
Before costs (£35.90 in all) the scanner made £-16.93; trading every signal the opposite way would have made £-48.59 after costs.
The scanner does not clearly beat chance: filters cannot create an edge that is not there, so the improvement has to come from the entry signal itself or from the exits.
B0. + breakout still past the zone by 0 typical candle ranges: helped in one half only, still loses money (average per trade £-0.16 v £-0.15; 335 trades)
B1. + breakout still past the zone by 0.1 typical candle ranges: did not help, still loses money (average per trade £-0.16 v £-0.15; 334 trades)
B2. + breakout still past the zone by 0.25 typical candle ranges: did not help, still loses money (average per trade £-0.17 v £-0.15; 330 trades)
B3. + breakout still past the zone by 0.5 typical candle ranges: did not help, still loses money (average per trade £-0.17 v £-0.15; 314 trades)
C. + at least 75% of the planned stop room left: did not help, still loses money (average per trade £-0.18 v £-0.15; 298 trades)
D. + stop not already traded through that day: helped in both halves, still loses money (average per trade £-0.04 v £-0.15; 116 trades)
E. + no trades in a sideways regime: helped in both halves, still loses money (average per trade £-0.14 v £-0.15; 357 trades)
F. + zone at least 2 trading hours old: did not help, still loses money (average per trade £-0.15 v £-0.15; 359 trades)
Self-search: no candidate held up on the unseen second half.
Exits: best was 'Direction only: open to 16:30' with £-24.32 v £-52.83 for the current exit (not better in both halves).
All results are paper research on about 60 days of one market period. Nothing changes live trading without Phil's agreement.
